name: Rainy Blue ~6 Gatsu no Ame~
source:
The protagonist and his childhood friend, Ao, both aspired to become artists, but her life was tragically cut short by a car accident. While the protagonist was despairing from the loss of his friend, a small doll that Ao had once given him came to life. The doll, named Aoi, encourages him not to give up on his life and his dreams of art.

[summarized from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1035]Getchu[/url] and [url=http://type-98.lix.jp/area_01/98/kako/rainyblue.htm]this review[/url]]
translation:
主人公与青梅竹马司条苍都梦想成为艺术家，但苍因车祸不幸早逝。主人公因失去朋友而绝望时，苍曾送给他的一只小人偶活了过来。名为苍依的人偶鼓励他，不要放弃生命与艺术梦想。

[根据[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1035]Getchu[/url]和[url=http://type-98.lix.jp/area_01/98/kako/rainyblue.htm]这篇评测[/url]的内容整理]
